sql: SELECT "tracks"."id" AS k, (CAST("tracks"."bytes" AS REAL) / "tracks"."milliseconds") AS m1 FROM "tracks" WHERE (CAST("tracks"."bytes" AS REAL) / "tracks"."milliseconds") IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: tracks.track file size per track playback length
why: track file size / track playback length: the catalogue declares track file size a rate over track playback length
rank tracks rows by track file size per track playback length

sql: SELECT "invoices"."id" AS k, "invoices"."total" AS m1 FROM "invoices" WHERE "invoices"."total" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: invoices.total amount charged on the invoice
why: rank invoices rows by total amount charged on the invoice

sql: SELECT "invoice_lines"."id" AS k, "invoice_lines"."unit_price" AS m1 FROM "invoice_lines" WHERE "invoice_lines"."unit_price" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
why: rank invoice_lines rows by price charged per unit sold
